title: AI Inflection-Point Detection Result
description: Output of 01_detect_inflection.py. Records which of the three detection tiers (trailer / ai_actor_email / velocity_inflection -- AAP §0.5.3.1) yielded the AI introduction date that partitions every metric into baseline and after periods. The schema cross-validates the `evidence` shape against the `tier_used` value: a velocity_inflection result MUST carry velocity-shaped evidence (week_start + ratio discriminators), a trailer result MUST carry trailer-shaped evidence (trailer_value discriminator), and an ai_actor_email result MUST carry ai_actor_email-shaped evidence (author_email discriminator). This closes the semantic-consistency gap surfaced at INC-1. The INC-1 semantic guarantee is enforced by the required-fields list per shape (the discriminator fields MUST be present); additional informational fields (e.g., author_name, subject, parents, branch_at_detection in the evidence, or _metadata, date_local_iso, phase_decomposition, AI-actor breakdowns at the root) are permitted alongside the required contract fields. additionalProperties is set to true at the root and inside each evidence shape; a mismatched evidence shape will still fail validation because the required discriminator fields will be missing.

tier_used.description: Which of the three detection tiers actually produced the signal. Tier 1 (trailer) wins first, then Tier 2 (ai_actor_email), then Tier 3 (velocity_inflection).

date_utc.description: The chosen inflection date in ISO-8601 UTC (e.g., 2026-02-25T02:58:59Z).

evidence.description: Structured evidence supporting the chosen tier. Shape varies by tier; the surrounding `oneOf` clause enforces that evidence matches ONE of the three known shapes, and the schema-level `allOf` cross-validates that the shape corresponds to `tier_used`.

justification.description: Single-paragraph rationale for the tier choice and the chosen date. Renderable in the report's Methodology section.

alternatives_considered.description: Tiers that were tried but did not yield a signal. May be empty.

allOf.description: Cross-validation: when tier_used=='trailer', evidence MUST conform to the trailer evidence shape (commit_sha + trailer_value + author_date).
Cross-validation: when tier_used=='ai_actor_email', evidence MUST conform to the ai_actor_email evidence shape (commit_sha + author_email + author_date).
Cross-validation: when tier_used=='velocity_inflection', evidence MUST conform to the velocity_inflection evidence shape (week_start + pre_window_mean + post_window_mean + ratio).

trailerEvidence.title: trailer evidence
trailerEvidence.description: Evidence shape for Tier 1 (Co-authored-by: trailer search). The trailer_value field MUST be present; it is the discriminator that distinguishes trailer evidence from the other two shapes. Additional informational fields (e.g., author_name, subject, parents, branch_at_detection) are permitted; only the discriminator and core contract fields are validated.

aiActorEmailEvidence.title: ai_actor_email evidence
aiActorEmailEvidence.description: Evidence shape for Tier 2 (AI-actor author-email pattern match). The author_email field MUST be present; it is the discriminator that distinguishes ai_actor_email evidence from the other two shapes. Additional informational fields (e.g., author_name, author_date_iso, committer_email, committer_name, committer_date_iso, subject, parents, branch_at_detection) are permitted; only the discriminator and core contract fields are validated.

velocityInflectionEvidence.title: velocity_inflection evidence
velocityInflectionEvidence.description: Evidence shape for Tier 3 (rolling-mean ratio inflection detection). The week_start + pre_window_mean + post_window_mean + ratio fields together describe the inflection week and its statistical signal. Additional informational fields are permitted; only the discriminator and core contract fields are validated.
